query ListScenes($storyboardId: ID!) {
  scenes(storyboardId: $storyboardId) {
    id
    storyboardId
    sceneNumber
    textDescription
    mediaType
    mediaUrl
    startTimeSeconds
    durationSeconds
    transitionType
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
